title: Parsing Visual Latents for Multimodal Spatial Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.31021v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Spatial reasoning across multiple views requires inferring the 3D relations between objects and the camera from 2D observations, which depends on cross-view correspondence and scene geometry that vision-language models (VLMs) do not reliably extract. Pretrained vision encoders already capture this information in their latent features, with CLIP linking objects to image regions, DINOv3 matching semantics across views, and VGGT encoding multi-view geometry. However, VLMs do not benefit from these features when we present them directly in context as grayscale feature images. We therefore propose LatentParse, a training-free framework that parses latent features into explicit spatial evidence for VLMs. In LatentParse, an analyst VLM probes the features of all three encoders with predefined tools that locate objects, track them across views, and measure motion between views. translated_title: 面向多模态空间推理的视觉潜在特征解析
translated_abstract: 跨视角空间推理需要从二维观测中推断物体与相机之间的三维关系，这依赖于跨视角对应关系和场景几何信息，而视觉语言模型（VLM）无法可靠地提取这些信息。预训练视觉编码器已在潜在特征中捕获了这些信息：CLIP 将物体与图像区域相关联，DINOv3 能够跨视角匹配语义，VGGT 则编码了多视角几何。然而，当我们将这些特征以灰度特征图像的形式直接呈现在上下文中时，VLM 并不能从中受益。因此，我们提出了 LatentParse，这是一个无需训练的框架，可将潜在特征解析为 VLM 可用的显式空间证据。在 LatentParse 中，一个分析型 VLM 使用预定义工具探测所有三个编码器的特征，这些工具可以定位物体、跨视角追踪物体以及测量视角间的运动。随后，它将结果提炼为一份简明的文本报告，供……
tldr: 提出了无需训练的 LatentParse 框架，将 CLIP、DINOv3 和 VGGT 等预训练视觉编码器的潜在特征解析为显式空间证据（定位物体、跨视角追踪、测量视角间运动），从而帮助 VLM 进行跨视角空间推理。
en_tdlr: LatentParse is a training-free framework that parses latent features from pretrained vision encoders (CLIP, DINOv3, VGGT) into explicit spatial evidence—locating objects, tracking them across views, and measuring inter-view motion—enabling VLMs to perform multi-view spatial reasoning.
